standard.summary: 限制梯度的最大范数，防止个别样本的异常梯度破坏整个更新方向。
standard.effect: 设为 1.0 是标准做法；设 0 禁用裁剪；设较大值（如 10）相当于几乎不裁剪。
standard.whenToUse: 几乎所有场景都建议保持默认 1.0；loss spike 频繁或 OOM 后恢复时可适当降低。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要设成 0（等于不裁剪），除非你明确知道梯度范数始终健康。

standard_en.summary: Caps the gradient norm, so an anomalous gradient from a single sample cannot wreck the whole update direction.
standard_en.effect: 1.0 is the standard practice; 0 disables clipping; a large value (10, say) amounts to almost no clipping.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default 1.0 is recommended in nearly every case; you can lower it a little when loss spikes are frequent or after recovering from an OOM.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not set it to 0 (the same as no clipping) unless you know for certain the gradient norm is always healthy.

advanced.principle: torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ 将所有参数的梯度视为一个向量，当总范数超过阈值时按比例缩放。AGC（Adaptive Gradient Clipping）则按参数范数的百分比裁剪，对不同大小的层自适应。
advanced.intervention: 在 optimizer.step() 之前介入梯度张量，按范数比例缩放。
advanced.expectedImpact: 防止梯度爆炸导致 NaN；对正常训练的收敛曲线影响很小。
advanced.tradeoffs: 过小的裁剪阈值会限制学习能力，导致收敛缓慢；gradient_guard_strategy 提供更精细的 AGC 替代方案。

advanced_en.principle: torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ treats all parameters' gradients as one vector, scaling proportionally when the total norm exceeds the threshold. AGC (Adaptive Gradient Clipping) instead clips by a percentage of the parameter norm, adapting to layers of different sizes.
advanced_en.intervention: Intervenes in gradient tensors before optimizer.step(), scaling by norm proportion.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Prevents gradient explosions turning into NaN; minimal effect on normal training's convergence curve.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Too small a clip threshold limits learning capacity and slows convergence; gradient_guard_strategy offers a finer AGC alternative.
